description: The execution read, `GET /v5/execution/list`: the transcribed reply, one ETHPERP Trade fill with an empty link id and a next-page cursor that the port's walk refuses to see twice. Nothing is derived. Docs-transcribed: K01's execution lists replace it.
expected: A backfill adds each fill once: an `exec_id` the stream already delivered is not counted again, a fill the gap missed is stored once, and the order ends as the exchange's (E29-S04, "No double counting"; E29-T05, a private session across a mid-sequence disconnect misses no execution).
